articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Trump Says Iranian Money Held by US Will 'Pay' for Damage Done to Ships: Oil Slips, Dow Futures Rise
articles.summary: U.S. stock futures rose and oil slipped after Trump said U.S.-held Iranian funds should cover future ship and cargo damage.
articles._summary: U.S. stock futures traded higher and crude oil prices slipped on Thursday after President Donald Trump said Iranian funds held by the U.S. should be used to pay for any future damage to ships and cargo. Dow futures gained 20.00 points, or 0.04%, to 51,914.00, while S&P 500 futures gained 6.25 points, or 0.08%, to 7,451.25. Nasdaq 100 futures advanced 37.75 points, or 0.13%, to 28,658.50 as of around 8:51 p.m. EDT. In commodities, WTI crude oil fell 0.05% to $92.14 per barrel, while Brent crude dropped 0.12% to $100.571 per barrel. Natural gas futures fell 0.28% to $2.9079 per MMBtu. Meanwhile, the U.S. dollar index, which tracks the greenback against a basket of currencies, stood at 101.423, down 0.01% on the day. Asian markets were lower, with South Korea’s KOSPI declining 3.68% to 6,835.76 and Japan’s Nikkei 225 falling 2.50% to 64,762.97.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普称美国持有的伊朗资金将为船舶受损“买单”：石油价格下滑，道琼斯指数期货上涨
articles._zh_summary: 在唐纳德·特朗普总统表示美国持有的伊朗资金应用于支付未来对船舶和货物的任何损害之后，美国股指期货交易走高，原油价格下跌。道指期货上涨 20.00 点，或 0.04%，至 51,914.00；标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 6.25 点，或 0.08%，至 7,451.25。截至晚上 8 点 51 分左右，纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨 37.75 点，涨幅为 0.13%，至 28,658.50 点。美东时间。大宗商品方面，WTI 原油下跌 0.05%，至每桶 92.14 美元，布伦特原油下跌 0.12%，至每桶 100.571 美元。天然气期货下跌 0.28%，至每 MMBtu 2.9079 美元。与此同时，追踪美元兑一篮子货币的美元指数报101.423，当日下跌0.01%。亚洲市场走低，韩国综合股价指数下跌 3.68%，至 6,835.76 点；日本日经 225 指数下跌 2.50%，至 64,762.97 点。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Gary Black Says Tesla's 14% Post-Earnings Selloff Shows Investors Took Management's 'Caution About Not Scaling' Autonomy to Heart
articles.summary: Gary Black says Tesla's post-earnings selloff shows investors reassessing self-driving expectations after earnings.
articles._summary: Black, managing partner at The Future Fund LLC , said on X that Tesla’s 14.5% decline marked its worst trading day since March 2025, adding that investors “took to heart management’s caution about not scaling up” until those vehicles demonstrated it was safe to do so. “We have long argued that at a 180x forward P/E the market was way too aggressive in assuming TSLA gets to the finish line first on unsupervised autonomy and that other competitors can’t match its ability to scale,” Black said.
articles._zh_headline: 加里·布莱克 (Gary Black) 表示，特斯拉财报后 14% 的抛售表明投资者认真对待管理层“不扩大规模”自主权的警告
articles._zh_summary: The Future Fund LLC 的管理合伙人 Black 在 X 上表示，特斯拉 14.5% 的跌幅是自 2025 年 3 月以来最糟糕的交易日，并补充说，投资者“牢记管理层关于不扩大规模的警告”，直到这些车辆证明这样做是安全的。 Black 表示：“我们长期以来一直认为，在 180 倍的预期市盈率下，市场假设 TSLA 在无人监督的自主性方面首先到达终点线，并且其他竞争对手无法匹敌其规模扩张能力，这太过激进了。”

articles.author: Khyathi Dalal
articles.headline: Bitcoin Slips To $64,000 As ETH, XRP, DOGE Tumble In Macro Sell-Off
articles.summary: Bitcoin dropped to $64,000 as a broader risk-off sentiment hit crypto markets following weak technology earnings that pressured equities.
articles._summary: Bitcoin fell to $64,000 as a broader risk-off move swept through crypto markets after disappointing technology earnings weighed on equities. The pullback pushed crypto market sentiment back into the Fear zone. Ted Pillows noted Bitcoin trading below its 200-week EMA has historically marked a long-term accumulation zone. If the traditional four-year cycle holds, the market bottom could form in Q4.
articles._zh_headline: ETH、XRP、DOGE 在宏观抛售中暴跌，比特币跌至 64,000 美元
articles._zh_summary: 令人失望的科技收益打压股市后，更广泛的避险举措席卷加密货币市场，比特币跌至 64,000 美元。此次回调将加密货币市场情绪推回到恐惧区域。 Ted Pillows 指出，比特币交易价格低于 200 周均线历来标志着一个长期积累区域。如果传统的四年周期成立，市场底部可能会在第四季度形成。

articles.author: Shivdeep Dhaliwal
articles.headline: Intel, Amkor Technology, MaxLinear, Lockheed Martin and Oracle: Why These 5 Stocks Are on Investors' Radars Today
articles.summary: INTC, AMKR, MXL, LMT, ORCL were among the stocks seen trending on Thursday, July 23, 2026.
articles._summary: These are the top stocks that gained the attention of retail traders and investors through the day. Intel stock fell 2.33% to $100.23, trading between an intraday high of $104.18 and a low of $99.24, with a 52-week range of $18.97 to $142.34. The shares rose 4.37% to $104.61 in extended trading. Intel beat second-quarter expectations, reporting adjusted EPS of 42 cents on revenue of $16.13 billion, driven by 25% year-over-year revenue growth.
articles._zh_headline: 英特尔、Amkor Technology、MaxLinear、Lockheed Martin 和 Oracle：为何这 5 只股票如今受到投资者关注
articles._zh_summary: 这些是全天吸引散户交易者和投资者关注的顶级股票。英特尔股价下跌 2.33%，至 100.23 美元，盘中最高点 104.18 美元，最低点 99.24 美元，52 周波动区间为 18.97 美元至 142.34 美元。该股在盘后交易中上涨 4.37%，至 104.61 美元。英特尔第二季度业绩超出预期，调整后每股收益为 42 美分，营收为 161.3 亿美元，营收同比增长 25%。

articles.author: Erica Kollmann
articles.headline: Trump Hits 60 Countries with 10% to 12.5% Tariffs as Temporary Levies Expire
articles.summary: Trump imposes new tariffs on imports from 60 countries, targeting those with weak anti-forced-labor laws.
articles._summary: President Donald Trump is rebuilding his tariff wall hours before a temporary global levy expires, keeping trade risk on Wall Street’s radar. The administration announced on Thursday that it will impose tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on imports from 60 trading partners at 12:01 a.m. ET Friday. The duties target countries accused of weak enforcement against goods made with forced labor and will replace a temporary 10% worldwide tariff expiring simultaneously.
articles._zh_headline: 临时征税到期后，特朗普对 60 个国家征收 10% 至 12.5% 的关税
articles._zh_summary: 唐纳德·特朗普总统正在临时全球征税到期前几个小时重建关税墙，这让华尔街继续关注贸易风险。美国政府周四宣布，将于美国东部时间周五中午 12:01 对来自 60 个贸易伙伴的进口商品征收 10% 至 12.5% 的关税。这些关税针对的是被指控对强迫劳动制造的商品执法不力的国家，并将取代同时到期的全球 10% 临时关税。

articles.author: Shivdeep Dhaliwal
articles.headline: Cathie Wood Scoops Up Tesla Shares as Stock Sinks, Ark Trims Robinhood Amid Crypto Weakness
articles.summary: Cathie Wood scooped up Tesla on its worst day in over a year, even as Ark kept selling down its Robinhood stake.
articles._summary: The buying came as the Elon Musk -led company’s stock sank after the company missed second-quarter adjusted earnings expectations, a result that pushed the shares toward their worst day in more than a year . Investors were digesting a softer quarter that highlighted pressure from discounting and weaker regulatory credit revenue, two factors that weighed on margins. Ark sold 40,553 shares of Robinhood through ARKW on the same day.
articles._zh_headline: 特斯拉股价下跌，凯西·伍德 (Cathie Wood) 买入特斯拉股票，Ark 在加密货币疲软之际削减 Robinhood
articles._zh_summary: 此次买入正值埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)领导的公司股价下跌之际，该公司未能达到第二季度调整后的盈利预期，这一结果导致该股跌至一年多来最糟糕的一天。投资者正在消化疲软的季度，凸显了贴现压力和监管信贷收入疲弱，这两个因素拖累了利润率。 Ark当天通过ARKW出售了40,553股Robinhood股票。
